stories.title: Cornell student who gave police leads in alleged rape says she feels ‘betrayed’ over its handling

en.title: Cornell student who gave police leads in alleged rape says she feels 'betrayed' over its handling
en.summary: A Cornell student who provided information to campus police in 2024 regarding an alleged rape at a fraternity house expressed feeling betrayed about how authorities handled the case.

stories.title: Brazil Elections Head to Runoff Between Lula and Bolsonaro Son

en.title: Brazil Elections Head to Runoff Between Lula and Bolsonaro Son
en.summary: Brazil's presidential election resulted in no majority winner in the first round, triggering a runoff between incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and challenger Flávio Bolsonaro in what appears to be a competitive race.

en.title: U.S. military removes bombers from U.K. air base following security incident

en.title: All B-1 bombers withdrawn from British air base amid Iran-backed threat, spokesperson says
en.summary: The U.S. Air Force withdrew all twelve B-1 bombers from a British air base in response to reported Iran-backed threats against the military installation.

stories.title: Brazil's presidential race heads to Lula–Bolsonaro run-off as right gains ground

en.title: Brazil's presidential race heads to Lula–Bolsonaro run-off as right gains ground
en.summary: Brazil will proceed to a presidential runoff after the first round of voting failed to produce a decisive outcome, with the contest expected to be highly polarized and closely monitored internationally.

stories.title: Cornell University police made drug arrest hours before alleged sexual assault

en.title: Cornell University police made drug arrest hours before alleged sexual assault
en.summary: Cornell University police arrested someone on drug charges at a fraternity house approximately 22 hours before a former student reported being drugged and sexually assaulted at the same location, according to campus crime records.

en.title: U.S. military removes bombers from U.K. base targeted in suspected terror plot
en.summary: The United States has relocated military bombers from a British air base that was identified as a potential terrorism target. The base had been used for long-range bombing operations.

stories.title: Two dead, 35 wounded in shooting at Georgia block party

en.title: Two dead, 35 wounded in shooting at Georgia block party
en.summary: A shooting at a Georgia block party resulted in two deaths and 35 injuries. The victims who died were men aged 20 and 23, and authorities have not yet identified a suspect or motive.
